summary: Iter5 Round-7 testing complete (Shop Pages + Shop Edit + Shop Messaging). Backend: 21/21 pytest pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_features.py covering: GET/PUT shop round-trip of banner_url/logo_url/opening_hours/is_open + delivery_mode/fee/per_area; auth gate (customer 401/403, admin override OK, unauth 401); POST /shops/{id}/messages anon requires email-or-phone (400), accepts with email, accepts with phone, body<2 → 400, body>2000 → 400, unknown shop → 404; logged-in customer message inherits user.id+email and accepts subject; GET /messages/seller scoped to own seller_id; admin sees all; unread-count returns {count:int}; customer 403; PUT /messages/{id}/read decrements unread, 404 unknown, 403 not-owner; DELETE removes the doc and 404 unknown. Frontend Playwright (admin login → ltg-general-trading@hotmail.com / Kokobleake1): /shop/:id loads with shop-name, shop-cod-banner, shop-status, shop-banner, shop-logo, contact-seller-btn (shop-products-grid empty because seed shop has 0 products → empty state); Contact Seller modal opens for logged-in user, contact-body fill + contact-send-btn → modal auto-closes (verified count=0 after send); /seller/shop/:id/edit form has every expected testid (name, description, area, hours, is-open, save) plus all 3 delivery-mode toggles (free/fixed/per_area); changing opening_hours and clicking save persisted (re-fetched GET /api/shops/{id}.opening_hours equals the new value); Seller dashboard Messages tab shows badge='7' with 8 message rows; mark-read decrements badge to '6'; delete removes a row (8→7); ANONYMOUS click on contact-seller-btn correctly redirects to /login?next=/shop/{id}.

issues: Maintenance-mode banner ("orders are paused") is permanently visible — fine if intentional but worth confirming with PM whether it should be a config flag.

action_items: Demo accounts admin@demo.com / seller@demo.com / customer@demo.com with password 1234 are NOT seeded (return 401). PRD/test_credentials.md still references them; either re-seed at startup or update docs. (Updated /app/memory/test_credentials.md to flag this.)
Seed data has only 1 public shop ('Test Shop') with 0 products — fine for iter5 unit testing but limits broader regression coverage; consider re-seeding the marketplace before iter6.
Optional: Persistent maintenance-mode banner is hardcoded; consider gating behind admin/settings flag.
critical_code_review_comments: POST /api/shops/{shop_id}/messages uses get_current_user via try/except HTTPException, but it does NOT re-raise non-auth HTTP errors (e.g., a 403 blocked-email user). Edge case: a logged-in but blocked user would silently fall into the anonymous branch.
send_shop_message rate-limiting is absent — anyone can spam a shop's inbox via the public POST endpoint. Suggest IP/email throttling or per-shop hourly cap.
ShopMessageIn allows arbitrarily long subject and customer_name fields (no max_length). Consider Pydantic Field constraints to prevent oversized payloads.

PUT /api/shops/{id} exposes ShopIn full-replace semantics — required fields (name, area) must always be sent or partial edits clobber data. Consider PATCH or partial-update Pydantic model for SellerShopEdit page robustness.
Messages list endpoint /api/messages/seller returns up to 500 docs without pagination. Will degrade as inbox grows; add cursor/limit params.
SellerDashboard.jsx is now ~1700 lines per test agent inspection. Splitting MessagesTab and ShopsTab into pages/seller/ subcomponents is overdue (carried from iter3/iter4).

success_rate.backend: 100% (21/21 iter5 + previously 66/66 regression — total 87 tests on file)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter5 critical flows: /shop/:id rendering, Contact Seller modal (logged-in + anon redirect), /seller/shop/:id/edit form fields & save persistence, Messages tab badge / mark-read / delete.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Five pytest files now: backend_test.py (25), test_iter2_features.py (18), test_iter3_features.py (15), test_iter4_features.py (8), test_iter5_features.py (21). The new iter5 file uses pymongo directly to bypass email-verification gate when signing up test sellers/customers — pattern: signup → users.update_one({email}, {$set:{email_verified:true}}) → login. This is the recommended pattern for any future test that needs a non-admin role since demo@ accounts are not seeded. Frontend testids confirmed working: shop-name, shop-cod-banner, shop-status, shop-banner, shop-logo, contact-seller-btn, contact-seller-modal, contact-subject, contact-body, contact-phone, contact-send-btn, shop-edit-form, shop-edit-{name,description,area,hours,is-open,save}, shop-edit-delivery-mode-{free,fixed,per_area}, shop-edit-area-{add,row-N,select-N,fee-N,remove-N}, seller-tab-messages, seller-messages-badge, seller-message-{id}, msg-{read,del,email,phone}-{id}, edit-shop-link, view-public-link.
rca of the issue: No issues found in iter5 features. The only friction was that PRD-referenced demo accounts (admin/seller/customer @demo.com / 1234) are not present in the database and tests authored against them fail at login. Mitigation applied: rewrote test fixtures to dynamically signup+verify dedicated TEST_ users via the public /api/auth/signup endpoint plus a direct Mongo email_verified flip; this isolates iter5 tests from any future demo-seed changes.
